newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: North Korea delays New York peace talks briefing.
newsitem.headline: North Korea delays New York peace talks briefing.

text.p: North Korea has postponed a briefing in New York by U.S. and South Korean officials on proposed peace talks for the Korean peninsula, a Seoul foreign ministry official said on Monday.
The briefing on a U.S.-South Korea plan for four-way peace talks, also including China, was scheduled for Wednesday.
But the official said Pyongyang put off the session by one week in a message relayed to the U.S. State Department through its U.N. mission in New York.
"We are still trying to find the reason for the delay," said the official, who declined to be named.
Pyongyang agreed to attend the meeting after apologising over an incursion into South Korea in September by one of its submarines, which landed 26 intruders.
North and South Korea are still technically at war following the 1950-1953 Korean conflict that ended in a truce, not a peace agreement.
